skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize characteristics, roles, motivations, and impacts of multinational corporations' foreign investments.
Analyze factors influencing the formulation, adjustment, and implementation of policies regulating multinational corporations' investments.
Select appropriate policy solutions based on economic data analysis.
Work independently and in teams to solve problems related to multinational corporation management policies.
Apply learned knowledge to analyze factors influencing and trends in adjusting policies regulating multinational corporations' investments in the context of international integration.
